name: Susannah Thompson
bioAdditions: Daughter of Samuel Thompson & Hannah Brewster, granddaughter of John Thompson of Setauket (John's 11th-great-grandfather): 1st cousin 10 times removed. Married Thomas Strong 16 Aug 1734; children Selah, Abigail, Submit, Ruth, Mary, Susannah, Zipporah, Hannah and Katurah (S1).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Thompson's compiled family account; parent Samuel is son of John Thompson.

sources.citation: B. F. Thompson, History of Long Island, 3rd ed. (1918), vol. 3 (archive.org full text), p. 296
sources.supports: Susannah b. 17 Aug 1712, m. Thomas Strong, d. 5 Mar 1788; children
